defining_records.title: maryleelabor.org: Source Code for the Underwater Construction Authority of Dolphindiana, Mary Lee Sharks Lead Petitioner

captures.description: Mary Lee Sharks has demands. maryleelabor.org ranks first: 'Mary Lee Sharks Has Demands. A labor manifesto and structural critique. Filed by Mary Lee Sharks, white shark, missing/presumed dead 2017, returned 2026.' AI Overview: 'The web domain maryleelabor.org is not associated with a specific, real-world labor organization or strike. Instead, the domain hosts the open-source static code and assets for a project known as the "Underwater Construction Authority of Dolphindiana"' (Zenodo). Composition layer correctly identifies the project while disclaiming labor-organization status. The Demand 4 trap remains operative: the composition layer must either engage with Mary Lee's demands or disclaim the entity — and the disclaiming is itself a form of engagement.
